skills.name: Return of Spring Dance (回春舞)
skills.line: Where I am, there is spring.
skills.description: SP Momo no Sei attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Fragrant Greeting (携芳意)
skills.line: Do you hear it? The whisper of blooming flowers.
skills.description: Exclusive Effect. Heals an allied target for 15% of max HP and grants Fresh Bud. ;Fresh Bud (新蕊) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': At the start of the bearer's turn, heals Momo no Sei for 10% of her max HP. Crit heals apply to all allies. Removes after 3 triggers and grants bloom to the bearer for 3 turns. ;Full Bloom (盛放) : :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': Increases ATK, DEF, and SPD by 50%.

upgrades.text: When Fresh Bud is removed, raises her Move Bar by 30%.
If an ally with Fresh Bud is on the field when SP Momo takes lethal damage, she becomes immune to that damage and removes all Fresh Bud.
If the healing lands a critical hit, additionally heals 1 non-summoned entity ally with the lowest HP percentage.
Upper Hand: Grants Fresh Bud to the ally with the lowest HP.

skills.name: Wakebloom (醒时花)
skills.line: Awaken in the midst of spring...
skills.description:
Exclusive Effect. When SP Momo no Sei's initial CRIT reaches 100%, damage taken is reduced by 35%; when an ally is revived gains Full Bloom for 2 turns.
Active Skill: Revives an allied target and grants them Fresh Bud. ;Fresh Bud (新蕊) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': At the start of the bearer's turn, heals Momo no Sei for 10% of her max HP. Crit heals apply to all allies. Removes after 3 triggers and grants bloom to the bearer for 3 turns. ;Full Bloom (盛放) : :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': Increases ATK, DEF, and SPD by 50%.

upgrades.text: When an ally is revived, heals them by 10% of SP Momo no Sei's max HP.
Allied target revived by Wakebloom gains 50% Move Bar raise.
Increases Full Bloom duration to 3 turns.
After an enemy action, if an allied target is KO'd, casts this skill without cost (triggers up to 3 times per battle).
